title: The man who never says a word

sources: Matthew 1:18-25 (Mary espoused to Joseph was found with child, of the Holy Ghost; “Joseph her husband, being a just man, and not willing publicly to expose her, was minded to put her away privately”; an angel in his sleep: “Joseph, son of David, fear not to take unto thee Mary thy wife, for that which is conceived in her, is of the Holy Ghost”; Joseph rising up from sleep did as the angel commanded and took unto him his wife). Douay-Rheims.
Matthew 2:13, 2:19-20, 2:22 (three further dreams; four in all). Matthew 13:55 (“the carpenter’s son”). No words of Joseph are recorded in any Gospel.

John Chrysostom, Homilies on Matthew 4 (Joseph’s gentleness while suspecting); Bernard of Clairvaux, Homilies in Praise of the Virgin Mother 2.14 (Joseph withdrew out of reverent awe). Deuteronomy 22:23-24.

Pius IX, Quemadmodum Deus (8 December 1870), Joseph declared patron of the universal Church. Solemnity of Saint Joseph, 19 March; Saint Joseph the Worker, 1 May (instituted by Pius XII, 1955). John Paul II, Redemptoris Custos (1989); Francis, Patris Corde (2020).
check: Joseph’s trade: Matthew 13:55 calls Jesus “the carpenter’s son” (Greek tekton, builder or craftsman). Confirm “carpenter”.
“The law gave him harsher options” glosses Deuteronomy 22:23-24 and public divorce; confirm wording.

hook.say: before the story, can i ask you something? when you get shocking news, do you talk it out or go quiet?
options: then this quiet man might surprise you.
same here. let’s see what he did with his silence.

steps.line: In Nazareth lived Joseph, a carpenter from the family of King David. He was promised in marriage to a young woman named Mary.
Then the news: Mary was expecting a child, and the child wasn’t his. In all four Gospels, Joseph never says a single word.
Joseph was a just man. The law gave him harsher options. He chose the gentlest: to end the engagement quietly, so Mary would not be shamed.

steps.q: Matthew calls Joseph “a just man” in the same breath as his plan to spare her. Why is that pairing striking?
o: Justice usually meant exposing a wrong
Just men were expected to marry anyway
The law forbade him to end it
steps.why: For Matthew, being just includes mercy. Saint John Chrysostom thought Joseph feared the worst and chose mercy anyway; others say he stepped back in awe. The Church hasn’t chosen.

steps.q: His mind is made up. He lies down to sleep. What happens in the night?
o: An angel speaks to him in a dream
His family tells him to leave town
steps.why: A dream. In Matthew’s telling, God speaks to Joseph in dreams, four times in all.

steps.line: An angel came to him in a dream. “Joseph, son of David, do not be afraid to take Mary as your wife. The child is from the Holy Spirit.”

steps.q: The angel tells Joseph to name the baby Jesus, Yeshua. What does the name mean?
steps.why: Yeshua means ‘the Lord saves.’ ‘God with us’ is Emmanuel, the other name Matthew quotes in this same scene. Naming him also made Joseph his legal father.

steps.line: Joseph woke up and did exactly what the angel said. He took Mary into his home. No speech. He just did it.
Today, Catholics honor Joseph as patron of the whole Church. Workers, fathers and families ask for his prayers, especially on March 19 and May 1.
steps.label: today

steps.q: Pope Pius XII added a second feast for Joseph in 1955: Saint Joseph the Worker, on May 1. Why that date?
o: It’s the traditional day Joseph died
It answered May Day with a working saint
It starts Mary’s month, so they pair up
steps.why: May 1 was already the workers’ day in much of the world. The Church gave it a carpenter who worked with his hands.

say: here’s what i love. joseph never gets a single line, but the gospel calls him just: faithful to God. his whole answer is what he did.
catholics honor him as the quiet guardian of jesus and mary. holiness doesn’t need a speech. showing up, and staying, is a way of saying yes.

steps.q: Joseph’s dreams aren’t over. In Matthew, what does his next dream tell him?
o: Go to Bethlehem for the census
Flee to Egypt with Mary and the child
steps.why: Herod was hunting the child. Again Joseph says nothing. He gets up in the night and goes.

today.say: today, be the quiet one who stays. one unglamorous thing for someone, done without announcing it: a fixed hinge, a dish washed, a ride given. if you pray, you can ask saint joseph to help.
options: lovely. don’t tell anyone. that’s the point.
